extName.message: Melo: private AI chat, by Kamelo

extDescription.message: Melo is a private AI chat in your browser that answers on your own computer. Plus a nudge for a temporary chat when it’s personal.

extDescriptionTeams.message: Kamelo Business masks personal and company details on your device before they reach ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or AI in work apps.
